# What should you charge for that groom, and which dogs should you book?

> Quote a groom so it earns your target per table hour, then paste the requests on your list and get the exact set of dogs that earns the most in a day. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/dog-grooming-day-planner/)
